protocol.purpose: oracle diagnostic only; analytic truth is used for the Jacobian and scoring, never for candidate construction
protocol.candidate_patch_equation: P1(y, xi) = I1(y + F_hat @ xi); unknown translation is absent
protocol.candidate_policy: same detector candidate positions for every Jacobian; no pair.visible or pair.target_visible mask; invalid affine image-border supports remain in the pool with a score floor
protocol.geometry_filter: top-1 pairs are passed to WebGPU local affine RANSAC; its centred-coordinate model is evaluated against the observed pairs and analytic truth only scores retained pairs
protocol.dedode_b_exclusion: The current fixed-shape DeDoDe-B descriptor samples one dense image feature map and has no candidate-centred affine patch API; warping its whole input would reintroduce unknown-translation cropping, while an atlas would reduce each 64-pixel support to about 8 pixels. It is therefore reported only in the preceding full-image oracle experiment, not this controlled support ablation.
protocol.detector: WGSL structure-tensor score with deterministic spatial quotas; no learned detector weights passed

results.candidate_filter: only detector validity and 64-pixel support inside image; no analytic physical visibility mask
